Class TurnstileHumanCheck

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.turnstile.TurnstileHumanCheck
All Implemented Interfaces:
WhoHumanCheck
public final class TurnstileHumanCheck extends Object implements WhoHumanCheck
Cloudflare Turnstile as who's human check. The page runs Turnstile's widget with the action of the endpoint it calls (email-send or email-sign-in) and sends the token it gets in the "Who-Human-Check" header. This check asks Cloudflare's siteverify API about the token and hands the answer to its TurnstileVerifier, which decides; TurnstileVerifier.strict(Set) passes only a success made for the same action and, when hostnames are listed, on one of them. Cloudflare lets a token be verified once.

A request without a token fails without calling Cloudflare. When Cloudflare cannot be reached, or answers an error, the request fails unless this check was made to fail open; a token Cloudflare refuses always fails.

      public TurnstileHumanCheck(org.springframework.web.client.RestClient restClient, URI verifyUrl, String secretKey, TurnstileVerifier verifier, boolean failOpen)
      Creates the check.
      Parameters:
      restClient - calls Cloudflare; its timeouts bound how long a request waits
      verifyUrl - the siteverify endpoint, normally DEFAULT_VERIFY_URL; another for a stand-in in tests
      secretKey - the widget's secret key
      verifier - decides whether Cloudflare's answer passes a request
      failOpen - true to let requests through when Cloudflare cannot be reached or answers an error
